narrative.summary: CVE-2024-21762: Fortinet FortiOS Out-of-Bound Write Vulnerability. Critical severity, CVSS 9.8. Source: nvd+kev.
narrative.affected_summary: 2 asset(s) run an affected version: PWR-FW-01 (nrldc-edge-fw01, 7.2.6, internet-facing), BNK-FW-01 (bank-dc-fw01, 7.0.13, internet-facing).
narrative.exploit_summary: CVE-2024-21762 is listed in the CISA KEV (added 2024-02-09). EPSS score 0.84589 (percentile 0.99703). Public exploit code reported. One early-warning signal: new_kev.
narrative.why_it_matters: The vulnerability is actively exploited in the wild and is present on two internet-facing firewalls in our inventory, making it a high remediation priority.
recommended_actions: Plan remediation for PWR-FW-01: upgrade to 7.2.7 or later, or apply vendor mitigation
Plan remediation for BNK-FW-01: upgrade to 7.0.14 or later, or apply vendor mitigation
Restrict internet exposure of affected interfaces until patched
Review the source references: https://fortiguard.com/psirt/FG-IR-24-015, https://www.cisa.gov/known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog?field_cve=CVE-2024-21762 before acting
